ai_summary.key_headline: Tactical Battle of Group F: Blågult's Modern Attack Challenges Carthage Eagles' Deep Block

sweden: Victor Lindelöf (back stiffness - doubtful for opener)

sweden.philosophy: Fluid positional play, high pressing, looking to feed Viktor Gyökeres and Alexander Isak early.

tunisia.philosophy: Low block defensive shape, compact midfield lines, launching swift counters through Msakni.

tactical_insights: Sweden will dominate possession but faces the challenge of breaking through Tunisia's highly organized defense.
Tunisia will look to disrupt Sweden's midfield progression using aggressive double-teaming in the center.
Viktor Gyökeres' physical runs inside the box will be the primary target for Swedish crossers.
